text:
maria: Heads up — follow-up from the kernel/attention RFC: we're trying a 'safe-mode' rollout for the new attention-optimized kernel (attn-x). Goal: limit blast radius and enable automatic fallback on perf regressions.
aj: sgtm. what's the exact gating? per-model flag or global? also want the telemetry we discussed.
taylor: per-model enablement preferred. we need to avoid noisy global flips during spikes.
maria: agreed. proposal: a 3-layer control:
  1) model config flag: `runtime.features.attn_x = on|off|canary` (per-model)
  2) rollout window + ramp: percent of traffic, per-region — starts at 1% -> 10% -> 50%
  3) automatic circuit-breaker: monitor P95 latency, error-rate, and token cost delta. if any breach for 5m, route traffic to fallback stack.
liam: fallback stack = list of kernels to try in order, right? what's the manifest format?
maria: example snippet in manifest (proto-ish):
```
model_config {
  id: "redwood/attn-test"
  runtime {
    features { attn_x: "canary" }
    fallback_stack: ["attn-legacy", "attn-quantized", "cpu-safe"]
  }
  rollout {
    windows: ["us-west-2:1%", "us-east-1:1%"]
  }
}
```
aj: Nice. Two operational asks: 1) make the circuit-breaker configurable per model (latency threshold, cooldown), 2) surface the current kernel map in the console (per-route view)
taylor: +1. and add a small heatmap for kernel flips so we can spot thundering fallback patterns.
ops-bot: deploybot: rollout job queued for attn-x canary across us-west-2/us-east-1. job id: rb-4456
liam: For rollback, should we have an operator command to immediately force everything to fallback? something like `/runtime-flag force-fallback attn-x`?
maria: yes — we should have a global escape hatch `runtime.force_fallback <kernel_name>` with audit log and require `@sre` approval for prod. Also allow staged overrides: `runtime.force_fallback <kernel_name> --scope model:redwood/attn-test`.
aj: We also discussed telemetry keys. Suggestion: emit `kernel.active`, `kernel.fallback_count`, `kernel.latency_p50/p95`, `kernel.token_cost_delta` with label {model, region, kernel_version, rollout_bucket}.
taylor: and a derived alert: if `fallback_count` / `requests` > 0.05 for 10m -> create pager for oncall.
sre-bot: incidentbot: alert rule created: kernel_fallback_rate > 5% for 10m -> P1 to eng-oncall
liam: One more: we should run a canary A/B eval on NLG quality for attn-x vs attn-legacy using stored prompt sets. Automated regression if BLEU/QA drop > threshold or hallucination metric increases.
maria: yes — link the quality check to rollout automation. if quality fails, we don't auto-scale rollout forward.
aj: Implementation tasks: 1) model-config schema update (add fallback_stack + thresholds) 2) runtime: per-request kernel selection + easy switch to fallback 3) telemetry & console UI 4) operator CLI + RBAC checks
maria: I'll open a follow-up ticket RNF-1123 and assign owners. can folks comment on small details in the ticket?
taylor: will do. also propose a post-rollout bake period of 48 hours where we keep higher sampling (10%) for extended telemetry.
liam: add a tiny experiment: when in canary, sample 0.1% of requests to also run attn-legacy in shadow mode to compute quality delta without affecting users.
aj: good call.
maria: ok wrapping up — action items on RNF-1123. tagging @aj @taylor @liam. thanks :thumbsup:
ops-bot: deploybot: job rb-4456 started (canary stage)
sre-bot: auditlog: runtime.force_fallback checked: none
